title: Stripe hero
description: White hero with a broad ribbon of fibrous colour (sky, orange, pink, violet) sweeping down the top right, a small live-figure line, a light two-tone headline and an indigo button, closed by a hairline strip of customer wordmarks.
notes: the ribbon reaches up behind a transparent header by underHeader px (set 0 when there's no header above)
phones show only the first sentence and a full-width button; the logo strip becomes a slow marquee
all motion is CSS, off under reduced motion; no JavaScript
